title: Tyler Herro: 'This is the most I've ever lost in my life'
text:
Tyler Herro: 'This is the most I've ever lost in my life' Rumors News & Analysis Salaries Player Rankings NBA 2K Rankings Free Agency NBA RUMORS Tyler Herro: 'This is the most I've ever lost in my life'
 HoopsHype Nov. 12, 2026, 5:14 a.m. ET NBACentral: Tyler Herro says this is the most he’s ever lost in his life. “This is the most I’ve ever lost in my life. We can’t just be smiling and thinking this is okay. Like, the goal here is to win. That’s why we get paid, to win games.” 😬 The Bucks are 1-11 on the season and currently on an eight-game losing streak. (Via @nbapresserwire )
